preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 2 and 200,000.
The vertices of each edge are within the range of the tree's vertices.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of edges to add is non-negative.
The minimum number of edges to add does not exceed the number of edges that could be added, which is N-1.
If the graph already has a Hamiltonian path, no edges need to be added.
If the graph does not have a Hamiltonian path, at least one edge must be added.
